episodes.synopsis: Goku is farming with Goten when Mr. Satan tries to give him 100 Million Zeni! Goten and Trunks try to find a gift to Videl.
episodes.title: A Peacetime Reward; Who Gets the 100,000,000 Zeni?!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta and his family go on a family trip while Goku trains. Beerus remembers the Super Saiyan God in his dream.
episodes.title: To the Promised Resort! Vegeta Takes a Family Trip?!

episodes.synopsis: Beerus and Whis track down the Super Saiyan God. Meanwhile, Bulma and her friends set up her birthday party.
episodes.title: Where Does the Dream Pick Up? Find the Super Saiyan God!

episodes.synopsis: The Pilaf Gang end up at Bulma's birthday party to steal the Dragon Balls, but they are sidetracked. Meanwhile, Goku trains on Kaio's planet.
episodes.title: Bid for the Dragon Balls! Pilaf and Crew's Impossible Mission!

episodes.synopsis: While Goku is training, Beerus shows up at Kaio's planet. Goku suggests that they fight against Kaio's wishes, but Goku is later beaten by Beerus as a Super Saiyan 3.
episodes.title: Showdown on King Kai's World! Goku vs. Beerus the Destroyer!

episodes.synopsis: Beerus arrives at Bulma's birthday party, and Vegeta tries his best to keep the God of Destruction under wraps for the time being.
episodes.title: Don't Anger the Destroyer! A Heart-Pounding Birthday Party

episodes.synopsis: The Z-Fighters attempt to subdue Beerus after he gets angry, to no avail. Vegeta transforms out of rage after witnessing Bulma get slapped.
episodes.title: How Dare You Do That to My Bulma! Vegeta's Metamorphosis of Fury?

episodes.synopsis: An enraged Vegeta fights Beerus, but is overwhelmed. Later, Beers wins a rock-paper-scissors contest against Oolong, and decides to destroy Earth. Before he can, Goku returns.
episodes.title: Goku Makes an Entrance! A Last Chance from Lord Beerus?

episodes.synopsis: After Goku asks Beerus for more time, they summon Shen Long to find out how to achieve the Super Saiyan God form. They perform the ritual and Goku becomes a Super Saiyan God.
episodes.title: Thanks for Waiting, Lord Beerus! A Super Saiyan God Is Born at Last!

episodes.synopsis: After successfully becoming a Super Saiyan God, Goku challenges Beerus to another fight.
episodes.title: Show Us, Goku! The Power of a Super Saiyan God!

episodes.synopsis: The battle between gods continues.
episodes.title: Let's Keep Going, Lord Beerus! The Battle of Gods!

episodes.synopsis: The destructive power of Goku and Beerus' fight puts the entire universe in danger.
episodes.title: The Universe Will Shatter? Clash! Destroyer vs. Super Saiyan God!

episodes.synopsis: Although Goku loses the Super Saiyan God form, he absorbs and retains its power, and continues to fight Beerus.
episodes.title: Goku, Surpass Super Saiyan God!

episodes.synopsis: The fight between Goku and Beerus reaches its climactic end.
episodes.title: This Is All the Power I've Got! A Settlement Between Gods

episodes.synopsis: After the battle with Beerus wraps up, a terrible visitor comes to Satan!?
episodes.title: Valiant Mr. Satan, Work a Miracle! A Challenge from Outer Space!

episodes.synopsis: With the battle over, one day Kuririn visits Goku. His unexpected request is…!? Meanwhile, Vegeta tries to convince Whis to make him one of his students by…?
episodes.title: Vegeta Becomes a Student?! Win Over Whis!

episodes.synopsis: Some time has passed on Earth. Gohan and Videl’s daughter is finally born!!
episodes.title: Pan Is Born! And Goku Goes on a Training Journey?!

episodes.synopsis: Goku departs Earth and begins training under Whis. The surprising training method is…!?
episodes.title: I'm Here, Too! Training Commences on Beerus' World

episodes.synopsis: Sorbet is eager to revive Frieza and receives the help of Pilaf and his gang.
episodes.title: Despair Redux! The Return of the Evil Emperor, Frieza!

episodes.synopsis: Jaco travels to Earth to give out a warning of Frieza's arrival.
episodes.title: A Warning from Jaco! Frieza and 1,000 Soldiers Close In

episodes.synopsis: Frieza's forces begin their raid on Planet Earth. Goku and Vegeta, oblivious to what is happening on Earth, continue their training under Whis.
episodes.title: The Start of Vengeance! The Frieza Force's Malice Strikes Gohan!

episodes.synopsis: Ginyu switches bodies with Tagoma and wreaks havoc on the Z-Fighters
episodes.title: Change! An Unexpected Return! His Name Is Ginyu!!

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Vegeta hear of Frieza's return and quickly teleport to Earth.
episodes.title: Earth! Gohan! Both on the Ropes! Hurry and Get Here, Goku!!

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Frieza go one-on-one. Goku wants to reveal his true power, and so he transforms...
episodes.title: Clash! Frieza vs. Goku; This Is the Result of My Training!

episodes.synopsis: Frieza reveals his new evolution and the battle truly begins.
episodes.title: A Full-Throttle Battle! The Vengeful Golden Frieza

episodes.synopsis: The battle continues as Frieza's weakness begins to make itself obvious.
episodes.title: A Chance Appears in a Tight Spot! Launch a Counteroffensive, Goku!

episodes.synopsis: With Goku badly injured, Vegeta steps in to face Frieza. Stronger than ever, Vegeta proves to be a challenge and an enraged Frieza destroys the planet! Protected by Whis, the Z-Fighters are given a chance to save Earth, if they act fast enough.
episodes.title: The Earth Explodes?! A Decisive Kamehameha!

episodes.synopsis: While training on Beerus' Planet, Goku and Vegeta meet Beerus' twin brother Champa.
episodes.title: The 6th Universe's Destroyer! His Name Is Champa!

episodes.synopsis: Beerus and Champa decided to hold a tournament between their universes to settle who gets to use the Super Dragon Balls.
episodes.title: Combat Matches Are a Go! The Captain Is Someone Stronger Than Goku

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Vegeta go find the two remaining members for Team Universe 7.
episodes.title: A Run-Through For the Competition! Who Are the Last Two Members?

episodes.synopsis: Jaco and Bulma visit Zuno to learn more about the Super Dragon Balls.
episodes.title: Off to See Master Zuno! Find Out Where the Super Dragon Balls Are!

episodes.synopsis: The tournament between Universe 6 and Universe 7 begins! The first match is going underway.
episodes.title: The Matches Begin! We're All Off to the "Planet with No Name!"

episodes.synopsis: It's Goku versus Botamo! After Goku's victory, he faces Frost, Universe 6's version of Frieza. Who wins the match...?
episodes.title: Surprise, 6th Universe! This is Super Saiyan Goku!

episodes.synopsis: The next contestant for Team Universe 7 is Piccolo. Frost is doing what?!
episodes.title: Piccolo vs. Frost! Stake It All on the Special Beam Cannon!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta battles Frost. After a short-lived fight, Vegeta is challenged by Magetta.
episodes.title: Turn Your Anger into Strength! Vegeta's Full-Bore Battle

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta is struggling during his match with Magetta. What is Magetta doing to Vegeta?!
episodes.title: An Unexpectedly Uphill Battle! Vegeta's Great Blast of Fury!

episodes.synopsis: The next match is between Vegeta and the Saiyan from Universe 6, Cabba. What secret power does Cabba possess?
episodes.title: Don't Forget Your Saiyan Pride! Vegeta vs. the 6th Universe's Saiyan

episodes.synopsis: The final contestant for Universe 6 is the confident, legendary assassin, Hit. Does Vegeta stand a chance?
episodes.title: The 6th Universe's Mightiest Warrior! Engage the Assassin Hit!

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Goku and Hit continues, however, Hit proves to be more formidable than anticipated.
episodes.title: A Developed "Time Skip" Counterstrike? Here Comes Goku's New Move!

episodes.synopsis: The winner of the tournament between Universe 6 and 7 is decided!
episodes.title: A Decision at Last! Is the Winner Beerus? Or Is it Champa?

episodes.synopsis: As the winners of the Tournament Universe 7 are given the Super Dragon Balls and make summon the Dragon for their wish.
episodes.title: Come Forth, Divine Dragon! And Grant My Wish, Peas and Carrots!

episodes.synopsis: The Tournament may be over, but Goku still wants to battle Monaku to see how really strong he is. While Beers and the rest of Dragon Ball Cast try and keep his secret hidden from Goku.
episodes.title: A Chaotic Victory Party! Showdown at Last?! Monaka vs. Goku!

episodes.synopsis: Pan is kidnapped thought to be defenseless by her captors, but as it turned out, the plan backfired.
episodes.title: Goku's Energy Is Out of Control?! The Struggle to Look After Pan

episodes.synopsis: While Monaka delivers super sweets of the Galaxy to Bulma, Trunks and Goten end up locking themselves in his truck. Finding trouble on a planet Pot-au-feu, Where Vegeta and Jaco have to go and rescue them.
episodes.title: The Seal of Planet Pot-au-feu; Secrets of the Unleashed Superhuman Water!

episodes.synopsis: With Vegeta losing all of his power to the copy of himself that was made from Superhuman Water, it is up to Goten and Trunks to defeat him. Mean while Goku is back at full health and training at Kaio's planet.
episodes.title: Vegeta Disappears?! Menace of the Duplicate Vegeta!

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Goku and Duplicate Vegeta Continues. Will Goku defeat the copy in time to save Vegeta?
episodes.title: Goku vs. the Duplicate Vegeta! Which One Is Going to Win?

episodes.synopsis: In the timeline of Future Trunks, a new enemy appears that requires him to return to the past and get help from the Z-Fighters.
episodes.title: SOS from the Future: A Dark New Enemy Appears!

episodes.synopsis: Much to everyone's surprise, a war-torn and unconscious Future Trunks arrives in the past after evading Black.
episodes.title: Hope!! Redux: Awaken in the Present, Trunks

episodes.synopsis: After awakening in the present, Future Trunks mistakes Goku for his evil look-alike Black.
episodes.title: A Message from the Future - The Incursion of Goku Black!

episodes.synopsis: Goku Black invades from Trunks' future! Excited to fight a strong opponent, Goku immediately challenges him to one-on-one combat, but Goku Black isn't taking the fight seriously?!
episodes.title: Goku vs. Black! A Closed-Off Road to the Future

episodes.synopsis: Bulma finds the Time Machine that Cell used to travel to the past and promptly gathers the team to repair it. Future Trunks and Mai discuss their counterparts from alternate timelines.
episodes.title: Feelings That Transcend Time: Trunks and Mai

episodes.synopsis: Piccolo mentions that Gohan decided to abandon his training to become a scholar, which suprised Future Trunks. Piccolo and Kuririn suggest that Future Trunks should meet their timeline's Gohan.
episodes.title: Master and Pupil Reunited! Gohan and "Future" Trunks!

episodes.synopsis: Goku, Beerus, and Whis arrive in Universe Ten. They meet the Supreme Kai Gowasu and his apprentice Zamasu.
episodes.title: Uncover Black's Identity! Off to the 10th Universe's World of the Kai's!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta wants to test Future Trunks' power to see how strong his son had become.
episodes.title: He Who Is of Saiyan Blood: Trunks's Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Whis and Beerus are worried over Zen-Oh's request to meet Goku and what it could mean for their universe.
episodes.title: I'd Like to See Goku, You See; A Summons From Grand Zeno!

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Vegeta appear in the future to fight Goku Black, but they find that he has developed a new power.
episodes.title: Rematch with Goku Black! Enter Super Saiyan Rosé

episodes.synopsis: Zamasu appears unexpectedly from the sky. He states that he and Goku Black are "kindred spirits" who want a world without mortals.
episodes.title: A God with an Invincible Body - The Advent of Zamasu

episodes.synopsis: Defeated, Son Goku, Vegeta and Trunks travel to the present, in order to find a way to defeat Zamasu. We also witness a developing relating to the mystery between Black and Zamasu.
episodes.title: Zamasu and Black - The Duo's Mystery Deepens

episodes.synopsis: Goku, Beerus and Whis must save Gowasu from his treacherous apprentice.
episodes.title: Protect the Supreme Kai Gowasu - Destroy Zamasu!

episodes.synopsis: Trunks returns to the future, with Goku and his parents accompanying him. There they discover Goku Black still lives, and he explains how he defied space and time to exist.
episodes.title: Into the Future Again - Goku Black's True Identity Revealed!

episodes.synopsis: Goku, Vegeta and Future Trunks fight Black and Zamasu in the future. Black explains his true identity.
episodes.title: Zamasu's Ambition – The Storied "Project 0 Mortals" of Terror

episodes.synopsis: With his new found power, Trunks attempts to hold off Black and Zamasu. Meanwhile, Goku and Vegeta head back to the past to try come up with a new strategy.
episodes.title: I Will Defend the World! Trunks' Furious Burst of Super Power!

episodes.synopsis: Trunks wakes up in a rebel base only to find out that Mai set off on her own in an attempt to take out Black. Will he make it in time to save her?
episodes.title: Don't You Disgrace Saiyan Cells! Vegeta's Fierce Battle Commences!

episodes.synopsis: As the battle rages on in the future, Bulma and Trunks devise a plan to take down Zamasu, meanwhile, Vegeta shows his new-found strength while taking on Goku Black.
episodes.title: Worship Me! Give Praise Unto Me! The Explosive Birth of a Merged Zamasu!

episodes.synopsis: The two zamasu fuse and become the ultimate god. Meanwhile Vegeta, Goku and others are stunned and try to somehow defeat the eternal god.
episodes.title: Final Judgement? The Ultimate Power of an Absolute God

episodes.synopsis: After Goku's attack shakes Zamazu's balance and reveal a weakness in him, he and Vegeta fuse together as they see hope to prevail. Nevertheless, It's Trunks's world and to him it all ultimately comes down.
episodes.title: Showdown! The Miraculous Power of Unyielding Warriors

episodes.synopsis: Zamasu makes one final almighty move to destroy the universe, but Goku brings out a forgotten but all-powerful ally to stop him.
episodes.title: With New Hope in His Heart - Farewell, Trunks

episodes.synopsis: Goku decides to summon Shenron to honor a promise, but his friends have things they want to wish for too.
episodes.title: Come Forth, Shenron! Whose Wish Will Be Granted?

episodes.synopsis: Goku and the android girl Arale Norimaki meet after many years, in a fun-filled episode where the cast of Dr Slump and DBZ meet.
episodes.title: Goku vs. Arale! An Off-the-Wall Battle Spells the End of the Earth?

episodes.synopsis: Chanpa returns, and offers a baseball game between him and Beerus.
episodes.title: A Challenge from Champa! This Time, a Baseball Game!

episodes.synopsis: Hit gets a contract to kill Goku, and prepares his assassination.
episodes.title: Goku Dies! An Assassination That Must Be Executed!

episodes.synopsis: Goku manages to come back to life, but he seeks a fight with Hit. And who is the client who put Hit to fight Goku?
episodes.title: Will He Strike Back? The Unseen Killing Technique!

episodes.synopsis: A film of the Great Saiyaman is to be made, and Gohan is to be in it - to his chagrin, as a stuntman.
episodes.title: Gohan's Plight! The Preposterous Great Saiyaman Film Adaptation?!

episodes.synopsis: Barry Kahn's attempts to sabotage Gohan get lethal when the alien parasite Watagash takes control of him.
episodes.title: For My Beloved Ones! The Indomitable Great Saiyaman!

episodes.synopsis: Krillin decides to train with Goku after a police battle goes bad, but can he match up to the Saiyan's level?
episodes.title: Goku and Krillin! Back to the Old Familiar Training Ground!

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Krillin fight against their old enemies such as Frieza and Cell in a form of nightmares in a mystical forest Master Roshi sent them to in order to fetch him a special herb.
episodes.title: Conquer the Terrifying Foes! Krillin's Fighting Spirit Rebounds!

episodes.synopsis: Goku goes and sees Zen-O to get the Tournament of Power going.
episodes.title: Let's Do It, Grand Zeno! The Universes' Best Tournament!!

episodes.synopsis: Goku gets an invitation to the Tournament of Power, an epic tournament between universes.
episodes.title: Even the Universes' Gods are Appalled?! The Lose-and-Perish Tournament of Power

episodes.synopsis: Majin Buu and Basil the Kicker continue to give Zen-Chan a show while they unravel the fight.
episodes.title: The 9th Universe's Kicking Basil vs. the 7th Universe's Majin Buu!!

episodes.synopsis: With Majin Buu and Basil's battle concluded, Gohan is the next warrior of Universe 7 to fight. The rusty warrior's opponent is Universe 9's Lavendar. Lavender, however, has a trick up his sleeve.
episodes.title: Awaken Your Dormant Fighting Spirit! Gohan's Fight!

episodes.synopsis: The greatest fighters of Universes 7 and 9, Goku and Bergamo, face off.
episodes.title: Bergamo the Crusher vs. Goku! Whose Strength Reaches the Wild Blue Yonder?

episodes.synopsis: After Goku won his battle against Bergamo, Toppo from Universe 11 challenges Goku for a fight.
episodes.title: Goku Must Pay; The Warrior of Justice Top Barges In!

episodes.synopsis: With the Zen-O Exhibition Match concluded and 48 hours until the Tournament of Power, Goku and Gohan search for the 10 warriors needed to complete Universe 7's team.
episodes.title: Field the All-7th-Universe Team! Who are the Mighty Ten?

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Gohan recruit Krillin to join the Tournament of Power.
episodes.title: Goku the Talent Scout; Recruit Krillin and Android 18

episodes.synopsis: Goku searches for Majin Buu, as the Supreme Kais of each universe hold a secret meeting without Universe 7.
episodes.title: The Universes Go into Action -- Each with Their Own Motives

episodes.synopsis: Goku travels to an isolated wildlife preserve run by Android 17, and attempts to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.
episodes.title: First Time Exchanging Blows! Android 17 vs. Goku!!

episodes.synopsis: Goku helps Android 17 pursue poachers from outer space.
episodes.title: Hunt the Poaching Ring! Goku and Android 17's Joint Struggle!

episodes.synopsis: In preparation for the tournament, Piccolo trains Gohan so that he may awaken the power he had long ago.
episodes.title: Gohan and Piccolo Master and Pupil Clash in Max Training!

episodes.synopsis: Goku arrives at the dojo run by Tienshinhan to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.
episodes.title: A Mysterious Beauty Appears! The Enigma of the Tien Shin-Style Dojo?

episodes.synopsis: Gohan tests his powers he rediscovered in an exhibition match against Goku. Gohan forces Goku to transform into Super Sayan God Blue.
episodes.title: Staring Down the Wall to be Overcome; Goku vs. Gohan

episodes.synopsis: The Warriors that are participating in the tournament are gathering while the tournament draws near other universes are gathering their warriors too.
episodes.title: Which Universe Will Win Their Place? The Mighty Warriors Gradually Assemble!

episodes.synopsis: While each of the Universes prepare for the Tournament of Power in their own ways, Universe 7 gets in a pinch when they learn Majin Buu will be unable to enter the competition.
episodes.title: A State of Emergency! Failure to Reach Ten Members!

episodes.synopsis: In a desperate move to keep the roster for the Tournament, Goku decides to revive his archenemy Frieza so he can compete.
episodes.title: You're Our Tenth Warrior! Goku Approaches Frieza!!

episodes.synopsis: Frieza is resurrected. However, a group of assassins come for him and Goku.
episodes.title: The Evil Emperor Returns! A Reception from Mysterious Assassins?

episodes.synopsis: Frieza goes on a rampage against the assassins sent to take him out. But if he takes too long, Universe 7 is disqualified and erased from the Tournament.
episodes.title: Most Heinous! Most Evil! Frieza's Rampage!

episodes.synopsis: The Tournament of Power is finally about to begin. Goku and the rest of the team head to the World of Void, site of the battle stage.
episodes.title: The Time Has Come! To the Null Realm with the Universes on the Line!

episodes.synopsis: The 80 warriors assemble in the fighting arena in the World of Void and the curtain rises on the battle for survival.
episodes.title: Survive! The Tournament of Power Begins at Last!

episodes.synopsis: The Universe 7 team is hit by a concentrated attack from the other universes.
episodes.title: Ah, the Uncertainty! A Universe Despairs!

episodes.synopsis: The Universes get a taste of what it's like to be erased, after universe 9 is wiped out of existence, Krillin begins showcasing his newly-found powers. Universe 7 loses it's first participant.
episodes.title: Show Them! Krillin's Underlying Strength!

episodes.synopsis: Kale unleashes her berserk Saiyan ability, but endangers her fellow teammates.
episodes.title: Rampage! A Crazed Warrior's Savagery Awakens!

episodes.synopsis: The Pride Troopers of Universe 11 launch an assault on Goku's team.
episodes.title: Warriors of Justice Close In! The Pride Troopers!

episodes.synopsis: The Universe 2 lady fighters make their move.
episodes.title: The Power of Love Explodes? The 2nd Universe's Witchy Warriors!

episodes.synopsis: Gohan goes up against Universe 10 warriors.
episodes.title: Gohan, Get Ruthless! Showdown with the 10th Universe!

episodes.synopsis: Hit and Dispo begin to fight at the speed of light. Hit is disadvantaged when Goku comes to help.
episodes.title: A Transcendent Light-Speed Battle Erupts! Goku and Hit's United Front!

episodes.synopsis: Master Roshi takes on the fighters of Universe 4.
episodes.title: A Valiant Fight! Master Roshi's Blaze of Glory!

episodes.synopsis: An unknown sniper with incredible aim launches a stealth attack in the Tournament.
episodes.title: Find them Out! Deathmatch with a Furtive Attacker!

episodes.synopsis: Frost recalls how Champa promised to pardon his crimes if he humiliated and defeated Universe 7.
episodes.title: Revenge "F"! A Cunning Trap Is Set?

episodes.synopsis: As Gohan Struggles, Freeza and Frost appear... together they approach Gohan! What!?
episodes.title: Frieza and Frost! A Mutual Malevolence?

episodes.synopsis: The Tournament of Power is now half over, and Jiren finally attacks.  Goku is forced to Super Saiyan Blue to keep pace with the overwhelming power of the 11th Universes most powerful warrior.
episodes.title: The Mightiest Enemy Zeroes In on Goku! Launch the Knockout Spirit Bomb Now!

episodes.synopsis: After a surprise counter by Jiren, Goku disappears inside the blast of his spirit bomb. Will this be the end for Universe 7?!
episodes.title: Goku Enkindled! The Awakened One's New Ultra Instinct!

episodes.synopsis: Hit uses his time-skip powers against Jiren and pools all his energy in a final attack to defeat him. Is this the end of Jiren?!
episodes.title: An Extra-Dimensional Ultimate Battle! Hit vs. Jiren!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta and Cabba stand to face Monna from Universe 4 to show the power of the proud warrior race.
episodes.title: A Saiyan Oath! Vegeta's Resolve!

episodes.synopsis: Exhausted from his battle with jiren, Goku and Caulifla fight.  Goku doesn’t have the strength to transform into a Super Saiyan yet, but he slowly gains his strength back during their fight.
episodes.title: With Great Joy! The Fighting Freak Saiyans' Battle Rejoined!

episodes.synopsis: Kale controls that fierce power and becomes a true legendary Super Saiyan!
episodes.title: Bloodcurdling! The Explosive Birth of a New Super Warrior!

episodes.synopsis: Kefla was born from the Potara fusion.  Her power and speed are unbelievable!  Goku has to fight Kefla using his Blue Kiao Ken in the Ultimate Saiyan showdown!
episodes.title: Goku vs. Kefla! Super Saiyan Blue Beaten?

episodes.synopsis: Goku unleashes stupendous ki.  In his battle with Kafla, he has once more reached Ultra Instinct.  His body unconsciously dodges Kafla's attacks, which triggers her to launch an even fiercer assault.  Then after avoiding her attack, Goku fires a Kamehameha at point-blank range!
episodes.title: Signs of a Turnabout! The Autonomous Ultra Instinct Erupts!

episodes.synopsis: Ribrianne targets Goku right as he's worn out from an intense battle!  But then 17 and 18 appear!  18 takes Goku's place and challenges Ribrianne to one-on-one combat, while 17 takes on Rozie.  Can the two of them prevail against Universe 2's strongest?!
episodes.title: Showdown of Love! The Androids vs. the 2ⁿᵈ Universe!

episodes.synopsis: Gohan and Piccolo's tough fight!  Gohan and Piccolo struggle against the desperate attacks of Universe 6's final warriors, Saonel and Pirina!  Piccolo therefore thinks up a method of attack their opponents won't expect.
episodes.title: Accelerating Tragedy - Vanishing Universes

episodes.synopsis: The Tournament of Power Continues and Universe 7 takes on Universe 4.
episodes.title: Unavoidable? The Ferocity of a Stealth Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Universe 3's Menacing Assassins attack Universe 7.
episodes.title: A Perfect Survival Strategy! The 3ʳᵈ Universe's Menacing Assassin!

episodes.synopsis: Universe 7's all-out war begins with the quadruple Merge from Universe 3 named Aniraza. Goku and all his team members take on the new opponent.
episodes.title: All-Out War! The Ultimate Four-Fold Union vs. the 7ᵗʰ Universe's Total Offensive!

episodes.synopsis: With 7 minutes remaining the fight to determine who will survive, Vegeta challenges the strongest warrior Jiren.  What!?
episodes.title: With His Pride on the Line! Vegeta's Challenge to Be the Strongest!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta puts his full power in display against the mighty warrior Jiren of Universe 11, but can he hold his ground against him?
episodes.title: Body, Soul and Power Unleashed! Goku and Vegeta!

episodes.synopsis: Frieza is about to eliminate Dyspo, but Dyspo suddenly shows his true power. Can Universe 7 be able to defeat this warrior with Lightning Speed?
episodes.title: A Storm-and-Stress Assault! Gohan's Last Stand!

episodes.synopsis: The Battle continues between Toppo and Android 17 but Toppo displays the power of a God of Destruction. Can this obstacle be destroyed?
episodes.title: A Commanding Presence! The Advent of Top the Destroyer!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta displays his full power against Toppo in this high heated Match. Can Vegeta be able to defeat him with his Final Trick?
episodes.title: Surpass Even a God! Vegeta's Sacrifice Strike!

episodes.synopsis: Android 17, Vegeta, Goku and Frieza maximize their struggle to defeat Jiren. Jiren releases his hidden power that surprises everyone. Android 17 shows Jiren his bravery and tries to mentally steer him into defeat. 17, protects Vegeta and Goku from a lethal attack from Jiren.
episodes.title: The Approaching Wall! A Hopeful Final Barrier!

episodes.synopsis: While Goku tries to master the Ultra Instinct, Vegeta still fights Jiren with everything he's got.
episodes.title: To the Noble, Proud End! Vegeta Falls!

episodes.synopsis: A super heated battle for survival continues. With Jiren puttin Goku on the ropes even after he awakens ultra instict Goku surrpasses his limits once again by mastering the ultra instict.
episodes.title: A Transcendent Limit Break! Autonomous Ultra Instinct Mastered!

episodes.synopsis: The climactic battle to decide the fate of Universe 7 continues as Goku, now mastering Ultra Instinct, fights Jiren at his full power.
episodes.title: The Greatest Showdown of All Time! The Ultimate Survival Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The Tournament of Power reaches its final climactic moment, as Goku, Frieza and 17 have to eliminate Jiren for the survival of Universe 7.
episodes.title: A Miraculous Conclusion! Farewell Goku! Until We Meet Again!
